title: Stripe Webhook & Automated Reconciliation
description: Implement Stripe webhook handler endpoint to capture checkout.session.completed and payment_intent.succeeded events, updating invoice status to paid and logging payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Webhook endpoint verifies Stripe event signatures with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
On payment.succeeded, updates invoice status to 'paid'
Creates a payment record in payments table and records transaction in ledger
Returns 200 HTTP status code to Stripe

steps.details: Create POST /api/webhooks/stripe endpoint with raw body parser for signature verification.
Extract invoiceId from session metadata and update status in Supabase database.
